result.stdout:
D3 — composable .NET project generator

Usage: d3 <command> [options]

Commands:
  new          Create a new .NET project
  init         Create D3 metadata for an existing project
  add          Add a feature pack or CRUD module
  profile      Manage reusable profiles
  template     Manage template sources and packages
  source       Manage package sources
  config       Read or update D3 preferences
  doctor       Check local tools and template availability
  validate     Validate the current D3 project
  help         Show terminal help or generate Markdown help
  completion   Print shell completion guidance
  version      Show the installed D3 version

Run 'd3 help <command>' for command-specific help.
Run 'd3 help -md' to generate Markdown documentation.
